tasks.short: Review applications against the vacancy requirements.

steps.what: Collect applications and the approved vacancy requirements
Read CVs and record evidence for each requirement

loop.input: Application text and approved requirement identifiers; exclude unrelated sensitive data.
loop.output: Unranked evidence table with source passages and explicit unknowns.
loop.check: Validate field types, source spans and requirement IDs. Recruiter checks every material claim against the original; no inferred traits or score.
loop.stop: At most two calls, 8,000 input tokens and 2,000 output tokens per call, 30 seconds total. Missing evidence, validation failure or timeout routes to the recruiter. No tools or external writes.
loop.why_not_simpler: Structured forms work first; varied CV prose needs extraction. A model must not select candidates.

steps.what: Compare evidence with requirements and record a screening decision
Resolve unclear qualifications and confirm the screening decision
File checked evidence and update the screening record

tasks.design: Keep Recruitee as the candidate record and add an evidence view on a governed service with a small extraction loop. Each application event builds an unranked dossier; the recruiter checks originals and records the screening decision before any stage event can drive communication.
tasks.previous_blocker: Hypothesis: free-text CVs and inconsistent vacancy requirements forced repeated reading and copying.
tasks.enabler_now: The supplied REST interfaces support joins; AI coding lowers implementation effort, while bounded extraction handles the text that forms cannot replace.
tasks.still_hard: Checking omissions and false equivalences can take as long as reading a short CV. A tidy table can still bias the reviewer.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise relevant experience expressed in unfamiliar language and let candidates correct missing evidence.

ambition.what: Offer a clarification route for applicants with nonstandard qualifications instead of silently treating missing evidence as failure.

tasks.altitude: The recruiter reviews evidence gaps and challenges unnecessary requirements. Hiring authority stays with the existing decision owners.

reach.learn: Job analysis and the difference between necessary and preferred criteria.

Send routine information about the role

tasks.short: Plan recruiting activity against current and future staffing needs.

Challenge demand and agree priorities with site managers

tasks.short: Coordinate temporary staffing orders with agencies.

steps.what: Clarify the requested shifts, skills, numbers and budget
Read agency availability files and reconcile conflicting replies

loop.input: Agency email for the approved order; CSV files follow a fixed parser.
loop.output: Order ID, site, shift, headcount, qualifications and quoted terms, each with source evidence.
loop.check: Validate counts, dates and order IDs; compare rates to approved terms. Recruiter resolves contradictory files and duplicate workers.
loop.stop: At most two calls, 8,000 input tokens and 2,000 output tokens per call, 30 seconds total. Missing evidence, validation failure or timeout routes to the recruiter. No tools or external writes.
loop.why_not_simpler: The stated portals offer email and CSV, not confirmed APIs. Deterministic CSV parsing works; remaining free text needs a bounded reader.

steps.what: Check the order and release the authorised commitment
Negotiate shortages, substitutions and changed terms
Confirm coverage and hand the agreed starts to the site

tasks.design: Replace the agency coordination sheet with a small order register on the governed service and a CSV/email intake for the three agencies. Generate approved orders and reconcile confirmations by order version; a bounded reader handles free-text replies, while people approve commitments and negotiate shortages.
tasks.previous_blocker: Hypothesis: conflicting versions of requests and confirmations are resolved across mailboxes and agency exports.
tasks.enabler_now: The supplied CSV exports and email channels permit a fixed intake and reconciliation flow; fast coding lowers the cost of adapting three formats.
tasks.still_hard: Agency promises can change before a shift. Identity clashes, certificate validity and shortages still need a named resolver.
tasks.human_edge: Negotiate a workable substitute and recognise when an agency promise cannot safely fill a shift.

ambition.what: Give each site a confirmed-starts list with unresolved skills and coverage gaps visible before the shift.

tasks.altitude: The recruiter owns the order exception queue and can return incomplete requests. Budget changes and worker suitability still need the authorised people.

reach.learn: Site induction, certificate requirements and minimal personal-data sharing.

tasks.short: Develop and evaluate applicant assessments with qualified specialists.

steps.what: Review job requirements and approved assessment standards
Draft job-sample exercises and assessment instructions
Review validity, accessibility and scoring with specialists
Evaluate pilot results and recommend revisions
Approve and publish the versioned assessment kit

tasks.design: Keep a versioned catalogue of job-sample exercises, instructions and approved scoring rules in SharePoint. Deterministic templates and pilot calculations support specialist review; an authorised person releases each kit, which the separate scheduling task uses without redesigning it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Hypothesis: assessment versions, scoring guidance and validation evidence are maintained separately.
tasks.enabler_now: Document templates, version control and reproducible calculations can be configured quickly without asking a model to invent a valid psychological test.
tasks.still_hard: Validity, sample size, adverse effects and specialist availability set the limit. Generated questions are not validated instruments.
tasks.human_edge: Judge whether the exercise reflects the actual job and whether an apparent failure arose from an inaccessible assessment.

ambition.what: Develop a reviewed warehouse job-sample exercise that applicants can complete without irrelevant office-test demands.

tasks.altitude: The recruiter owns assessment logistics and version history. Psychometric and medical competence are not created by the software.

reach.learn: Measurement limits, accessible job samples and specialist escalation.

role.altitude: The two recruiters run candidate conversations, hiring evidence and agency exceptions. One leads candidate experience and decision follow-up; the other leads sourcing, agency relationships and site planning, with cross-cover. They gain ownership of data quality, update promises and improvement proposals, not unilateral hiring, pay or assessment authority.
reach: hr-admin: prepare complete permanent and flex start handoffs; learn AFAS field and induction requirements.
hrbp: improve vacancy briefs and coach structured interviewing; learn job analysis and fair selection.
people-analyst: prepare source-to-day-90 cohorts; learn denominator design, uncertainty and lawful data use.
skills_to_grow: Write and maintain explicit workflow rules and approval boundaries.
Read API/CSV errors, reconcile duplicates and verify record versions.
Conduct structured interviews and challenge missing evidence without relying on a score.
Apply privacy minimisation, retention, candidate correction rights and AI oversight.
Separate labour capacity, queue time and productive retained hires when measuring results.
role.ambitious_version: The hiring team provides a clear route from vacancy to a productive retained hire, including applicants on shifts and flex workers seeking permanence. Returned time funds manager decision sessions, candid job previews and follow-up on onboarding gaps; demand and outcomes must be tested before promising more hires. The governing North Star is the share of open roles filled by someone productive and still present at day 90, with cohorts fixed at vacancy opening and immature outcomes shown separately.
